effect: The lamp is installed and both goals are complete.
reaction: A reassuring finish, though I wanted a more vivid indication of the garden's condition.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the reservoir wick was the most interesting action: a passive water feed fits the need to conserve power and invited me to think about capillary action.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive assembly results mostly renamed items without explaining their operation or showing the garden respond, so the middle felt routine.

surprise.text: I expected the wick to be a watering route, but did not initially know which bed it would serve; the next menu specified lettuce.

arbitrary.text: The different watering arrangements for lettuce and potatoes had a clear overall purpose, but I did not learn why each particular bed got its assigned system.

continue.text: I would continue for the larger mystery of the preserved body, but this chapter alone offered mostly predictable assembly and little new feedback about the plants.
